name: Mirror Garden · KARMA Operations
meaning: Make defensive readiness, incident response, corrections, coverage gaps, and reviewed learning legible without publishing sensitive evidence or creating an attacker oracle.
principles: make the surface, evidence state, owner, rollback, and unknowns easy to find
publish categories and service actions, never raw attempts, identity, or intent
default to derived categorical evidence; raw retention needs a separate scoped exception and deletion proof
keep live classification, telemetry, synthetic mirrors, and automatic actuation disabled
turn only reviewed technique families into independently authored synthetic regressions
append corrections and supersession instead of erasing earlier public explanations
use love as a care boundary, never retaliation or attacker-authored advertising
